scope: Scoped unchanged kitchen faucet, casting and support review following the roof-program and carried-light rotation fix. No geometry or material edits in this batch; not whole-world photorealism or human acceptance.

images.observation: Standard rolled basin and drainboard bear on outboard rails and saddles; no rear rail crosses the inner bowl.
Countertop basin sits on the worktop, with separate labeled cross handles, a curved spout, open drain and visible running stream.
Compact bowl and drainboard sit on the compact frame; the basin underside clears the frame.
Upper-floor standard casting retains visible support saddles and a clear interior.
